description: Use this when the user asks how much self-employment tax or total federal tax they owe for 2026 on 1099 income: a self employment tax calculator or 1099 tax calculator, 'I made 60k on 1099, how much do I owe', 'how much to set aside for taxes as a freelancer', DoorDash/Uber/Etsy gig income taxes, or 1099 income on top of a W-2 job. Computes Schedule SE self-employment tax (92.35% of net profit, 12.4% Social Security up to the $184,500 wage base minus W-2 wages, 2.9% Medicare, 0.9% Additional Medicare Tax), the deductible half, the QBI deduction, 2026 federal income tax with the standard deduction and child tax credit, withholding offset, and the percent of profit to set aside. Returns a PDF worksheet and a calendar file. For whether quarterly payments are needed, how much to pay each quarter, safe-harbor amounts, or a missed payment, use plan_quarterly_payments. Federal only; does not file taxes, compute state tax, or give tax advice. Do not use for explaining what a 1099 form is or for filing a return.

age_65_or_older_count.description: How many filers are 65 or older by the end of 2026 (born before Jan 2, 1962), e.g. 1. Adds the extra standard deduction and the $6,000 senior deduction.

business_expenses.description: Deductible 2026 business expenses in USD (Schedule C), e.g. 12000 for mileage, phone, software, home office. Expenses larger than income create a loss.

business_w2_wages_paid.description: W-2 wages the business paid to employees in 2026 in USD, e.g. 0 for a solo freelancer. Only used for the QBI wage limit above the threshold.

cash_charitable_donations.description: Cash gifts to charity in USD, e.g. 500. Non-itemizers deduct up to $1,000 ($2,000 joint) starting in 2026.

children_under_17.description: Qualifying children under 17 at the end of 2026 for the $2,200 child tax credit, e.g. 2.

federal_withholding.description: Federal income tax expected to be withheld from 2026 paychecks (W-2 box 2), for both spouses if joint, e.g. 4500.

filing_status.description: 2026 federal filing status, e.g. single. Values: single, married_joint, married_separate, head_of_household, qualifying_surviving_spouse.

is_specified_service_business.description: Only matters when taxable income is above the 2026 QBI threshold ($201,750; $403,500 joint): true for a specified service business (consulting, health, law, accounting, financial services, performing arts, athletics), false otherwise, e.g. false. If omitted, the lower SSTB result is used.

itemized_deductions.description: Total itemized deductions in USD if the user itemizes, e.g. 35000. The larger of this and the 2026 standard deduction is used.

other_credits.description: Other nonrefundable credits the user already knows in USD, e.g. 1000 (child care or education credits).

other_income.description: Other taxable income taxed at ordinary rates in USD, e.g. 1200 of interest or unemployment. Long-term capital gains and qualified dividends are not supported.

qbi_eligible.description: Whether the business qualifies for the 20% qualified business income (QBI) deduction, e.g. true (default). Set false to leave it out.

retirement_contributions.description: Deductible SEP-IRA or solo 401(k) contributions for 2026 in USD, e.g. 10000. Contribution limits are not checked.

self_employed_health_insurance.description: Self-employed health insurance premiums paid in 2026 in USD, e.g. 6000 (deduction, capped at business profit).

self_employment_income.description: Expected 2026 gross 1099 / self-employment income in USD before expenses, e.g. 85000 (freelance, contractor, DoorDash, Uber, Etsy). If the user only knows net profit, put it here and leave business_expenses out.

spouse_business_expenses.description: married_joint only: spouse's business expenses in USD, e.g. 4000.

spouse_self_employment_income.description: married_joint only: spouse's gross self-employment income in USD, e.g. 30000. Each spouse's self-employment tax is figured separately.

spouse_w2_wages.description: married_joint only: spouse's W-2 wages in USD, e.g. 65000.

state.description: Two-letter US state code, e.g. TX. Only used to say whether state income tax applies; state tax is not calculated.

w2_wages.description: 2026 W-2 wages from a job (Social Security wages, box 3) in USD, e.g. 40000. These reduce the room under the $184,500 Social Security wage base.

name: calculate_self_employment_tax
title: Calculate self-employment tax
